This query should correctly calculate the average response time for Bob Smith in a calm and quiet environment.

<solution>SELECT AVG(r.response_time) AS average_response_time
FROM responses r
JOIN trials t ON r.trial_id = t.trial_id
JOIN user_sessions us ON r.trial_id = us.trial_id
JOIN users u ON us.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN conditions c ON t.condition_id = c.condition_id
WHERE u.user_name = 'Bob Smith'
  AND c.condition_description = 'Low Condition';</solution>
